acceptance: "A grep of every narration script for \"pype\" is covered by the pronunciation rule, and the rendered audio is re-checked." (447 acceptance)
scope: Automatic speech recognition over the rendered English narration that says PyPI, as a machine re-check of the rendered audio. Not a human listening review.

published_media.note: The same af_heart track (sha256 ae049364...) is also what the older roots cd1de23e and f0ded2a7 (main Pages) serve for lesson 01.

search.method: Fetched the hosted en/af_heart.json timing sidecar of all 85 lessons and matched PyPI/pype in each scene text and speech_text.

scenes_saying_pypi.text: On PyPI, find spaCR and read the installation command beside the current release

rule.intended: one syllable with the vowel and final consonant of "pipe"; never "pie pee", PyPy, pypie or letters

asr.engine: faster-whisper 1.2.1, CPU int8, beam 5, language en, no prompt, condition_on_previous_text false; clip = the scene speech window only

control: A tracked but unserved legacy copy (docs/source/_extra/tutorials/production/01_pypi_github/audio/en/af_heart.m4a, 2026-08-04 render, speech_text "pie pee") transcribes as "PyP", so the ASR does separate the two-syllable form from the single-syllable "pipe".

verdict.summary: Both small.en and medium.en hear the hosted lesson 01 scene 2 as "On pipe, find spacer ..." : one syllable, the pipe vowel and final p, as the v11 rule intends.

legacy_note: docs/source/_extra/tutorials/production/01_pypi_github/audio/en/ still tracks 27 other 2026-08 English voices whose sidecars say "pie pee". They are not served (Pages 404, not in the release manifest, which has af_heart only); _REJECTED_PYPI_ALIAS does not match "pie pee", so a future re-use of those files would not be caught by the rule.
